items.title: Gonna be super interesting questions for Adelman/staff to face: Which bench players do they *need* more? Who "deserves" more minutes? Who do they want to just give some run (ie Whitmore) to try out?
items.author: Joel Rush
items.body_excerpt:
Gonna be super interesting questions for Adelman/staff to face: Which bench players do they *need* more? Who "deserves" more minutes? Who do they want to just give some run (ie Whitmore) to try out?

But to me, both Diallo & Strawther are "earning" spots. That raises dilemmas.

quote.author: Joel Rush
quote.text:
I want to see more from Trevon Brazile/Cam Whitmore.

But in practical terms, the #Nuggets need: Tyus Jones' playmaking as backup PG, Bagley to back up Jok, Spencer to hold the bench together. To me that leaves: Alpha as defensive disruptor & Strawther as Tim offense replacement.
